reason: On a record page, the "More like this" block is computed (three nearest posts sharing a use case), so adding a record to the column can displace one of the three. That is a recommendation changing, not a navigation link being dropped: the displaced page is still linked from the column hub, from the sitemap, and from its own related blocks. 2026-09-24, when batch 1 added twenty records and the guard read it as seventeen dropped links. The block itself is now marked `data-generated`, which makes this exemption redundant on the live site once this build has shipped — kept because the guard compares against production, and production will keep changing under us.
